bench_repair.name: Bench repair
bench_repair.instructions: Replace the broken plank, remove or cover exposed screws, check the frame.

fence_inspection.name: Fence inspection
fence_inspection.instructions: Check posts and boards; fix loose boards on the spot or open a follow-up.

paving_repair.name: Paving repair
paving_repair.instructions: Reset loose stones, replace broken ones, compact and sweep.

lamp_replacement.name: Lamp replacement
lamp_replacement.instructions: Isolate the circuit, replace the LED lamp, test at dusk mode.
